NERVA_AUDIT_KEY.purpose: Required by NERVA_HARDENED=1: the audit chain is HMAC-keyed with it, so an attacker with DB write access cannot forge the chain.

NERVA_AUTO_DEEP.purpose: H7.5: complexity-based escalation — light requests use the fast VRAM model, heavy ones (long context or reasoning cues) use the deep slot (DDR5 spillover). Set NERVA_AUTO_DEEP=0 to disable escalation;

NERVA_AUX_ACQUISITION_DRAFT_MODEL.purpose: Acquisition captures its model once for both JSON attempts.

NERVA_SAFE_MODE.purpose: Safe mode (H275/H490): the hub starts with owner jobs and loosened settings left out.

NERVA_SKILL_SIGNING_KEY.purpose: Skills supply chain (H12.12, anti-ClawHub). Installs are always zip-slip-safe; these add opt-in enforcement on top of the metadata the HUD already surfaces: - NERVA_REQUIRE_REVIEWED_SKILLS=1 → only marketplace skills moderated to 'approved'…

NERVA_STRICT_LOCAL.purpose: Keep model calls on local backends: a cloud model or judge is refused while it is on.

NERVA_STRICT_MODELS.purpose: Refuse a model outside an agent's approved_models (default on; 0 only logs the violation).

NERVA_TERMINAL_LOCAL_HOST.purpose: OFF: the local-host inventory row is absent and LocalHostTransport is not constructed — the refusal is the byte-identical local_transport_not_implemented.

NERVA_TERMINAL_LOCAL_ROOTS.purpose: OFF: the local-host inventory row is absent and LocalHostTransport is not constructed — the refusal is the byte-identical local_transport_not_implemented.

NERVA_UNIFIED_ACTION_API.purpose: 1 = enable the H27 capability action plane

NERVA_USER_HOME.purpose: The owner's data folder (packaged installs); its .env is the second .env layer the hub loads.

NERVA_USER_TOKEN.purpose: Protects the user-facing routes (the assistant /chat, personal memory & notes, code execution) — one tier below admin (HF-1). - Leave EMPTY: these work only from localhost (safe for a local laptop).

TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS.purpose: Group gating (Hermes absorption 0.4). In a group the bot answers only when it is @mentioned or replied to (TELEGRAM_GROUP_REQUIRE_MENTION=1, the default).

TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS.purpose: Telegram owner allowlist (comma-separated user ids). Empty is valid — sender pairing is the primary gate — but the approval-callback owner check needs either this or autonomy.owner_chat_id, and fails closed with neither.
